title: The word the writer meant
question: Which of V57's lines (the final AI draft for Caplet, landed 08:26 Wed 4 Nov) has only been checked by the people who wrote it, and is each one true at its source and beside our own submitted TNA? (round 8 beat 2; Q16 aimed at V57)
serves: North star 4 (investing knowledge, applied and true); Wharton: Investment Strategy (define a high degree of funding certainty) and all three deliverables judged together (the TNA is locked)

rounds.name: Felix checks V57 at its sources; a cold checker takes the case, the book and the TNA
Kai breaks the fixes, Tess reads the sources and the TNA
Felix lands it, with Kai's dissent kept

seeds: Does 'Her income already rides on booms' say back better than 'rides on shares' to strangers? (Writing Room, 16:20)
Three false versions for Kai's card for Caplet's rewrite: 'we don't duration-match', 'the funds pay exactly what they promised', 'the ladder's one weakness' (Genius Lab, 13:40)
essence: We checked every new investing idea in the final draft at its source (the 1987 crash report, the US and Australian regulators on capital-protected notes, a 1995 finance paper, a medicine leaflet), and every one is true.

But our submitted trading notes already told the judges the bond funds pay what they are worth at the end, not a promised amount, while the draft says a Treasury held to maturity pays exactly what it promised, right after naming the funds.
One word fixes it ('a Treasury bond'), and another ('main' for 'one weakness') removes a second clash; Kai voted against the first because the sentence is already true of a bond.
decided: No false line in V57 or its pitch
Near-breach: P4 'A Treasury held to maturity pays exactly' v the TNA's 'as opposed to a promise of par'; offer 'bond' (+1, 497 strict), 2-1, Kai against
Near-breach: P8 'one weakness' v the TNA's 'catch'; offer 'main' (+0), Tess
CORD (Felix): 'matching every payment matches the timing too' only roughly true; ladder about 7.6 v 10.0 years (Kai, MODEL); Caplet's rewrite says 'each payment has its own bond'
P5 'tend to dry up' VERIFIED (W-09); 'rides on shares' OVERSTATED (Tess); 'booms' offered (+0) as an ear call
